uwp_capture_status: partial: Scenario 1 (Data Events) captured live from the UWP CoreWindow; Scenario 2 (Polling) could not be captured live because the UWP CoreWindow XAML tree is opaque to UI Automation (hosted by ApplicationFrameHost) and synthetic input/foreground activation is blocked in this non-interactive session, so title/keyboard/coordinate navigation to the Polling page did not route. Scenario 2 ground truth taken from UWP source (Scenario2_Polling.xaml.cs).

features.name: Scenario navigation list
features.description: A left-hand list exposes the two scenarios ('1) Data Events', '2) Polling') and selecting one shows that scenario's page on the right, matching the UWP SDK sample shell.
expected_behaviour: List shows exactly two items: '1) Data Events' and '2) Polling'
Selecting an item highlights it and swaps the right-hand content pane to that scenario
Item titles are verbatim from the UWP source

features.name: Data Events Enable/Disable buttons
features.description: The Data Events scenario registers/unregisters an altimeter ReadingChanged event listener via Enable/Disable buttons; the Enable handler starts the report interval and swaps enabled state, the Disable handler stops it.
expected_behaviour: Both 'Enable' and 'Disable' buttons are present with those exact labels
Handlers ScenarioEnable/ScenarioDisable are wired (register/unregister ReadingChanged, toggle button enabled state)
With a real altimeter, Enable begins updates and disables itself while enabling Disable

features.name: Data Events altitude output
features.description: The scenario displays 'Altitude change(m):' with a value that updates on each ReadingChanged event (ScenarioOutput_M).
expected_behaviour: Label 'Altitude change(m):' is shown with an output value ('No data' when no readings)
Value would update to a formatted altitude change when the sensor reports

features.name: Polling Get Data button
features.description: The Polling scenario reads the current altimeter value on demand via a 'Get Data' button (ScenarioGetData handler calls sensor.GetCurrentReading()).
expected_behaviour: A 'Get Data' button is present with that exact label
Handler ScenarioGetData is wired to read the current altimeter reading
With a real altimeter, clicking updates the altitude change output

features.name: Polling altitude output
features.description: The Polling scenario displays 'Altitude change(m):' with a value updated when Get Data is clicked.
expected_behaviour: Label 'Altitude change(m):' shown with an output value ('No data' initially)
Value updates to the current formatted altitude change on Get Data when a sensor is present

features.name: No-altimeter status handling
features.description: On hardware without an altimeter, both scenarios report 'No altimeter found' via the shared status banner (NotifyUser / StatusBlock).
expected_behaviour: A red status banner shows 'No altimeter found' when no altimeter is present
Scenarios degrade gracefully rather than crashing
